instruction: Could you help me export all messages from the inbox to ~/email_export? Save each one as an individual .eml file.

expect: 歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.*\.eml

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting all inbox emails to ~/email_export folder in .eml format. Evaluator verifies that .eml files with expected email subjects are created. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match the known email subjects in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires exporting 'ALL messages from the inbox' but evaluator only checks for 2 specific email subjects
The evaluator would pass even if only 2 out of N emails in the inbox were exported, missing the completeness requirement
Without knowing the total number of emails in the Thunderbird inbox, we cannot verify all emails were exported
The evaluator logic itself is correct (ls -R + check_list with regex patterns works), but it doesn't verify the 'all messages' requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Determine the total number of emails in the Thunderbird inbox from the profile data
Add a check to verify that the number of .eml files exported matches the expected total count
Either: (1) verify all email subjects explicitly, or (2) add a count-based metric to check_list rules, or (3) clarify in instruction/metadata that only specific emails need to be verified
If only sample verification is intended, update the instruction to say 'export inbox emails' instead of 'export ALL messages' to match the evaluator scope
